receipts.detail: the bootstrap request carries expectedClusterId from the joiner delegates; a fresh joiner sends none (compatibility policy)
the seed-side admission owner refuses a foreign cluster id with the typed 409 CLUSTER_ID_MISMATCH rejection (terminal on the joiner via the existing conflict classification)
a pre-identity joiner (no expectedClusterId) and a pre-identity seed are both handled by the explicit UNKNOWN compatibility policy, never silent acceptance as a match
the bootstrap response builder stamps the durable cluster identity (request-owner getClusterId delegate) so a pre-identity joiner learns it
